description: Taifoon TEE (product taifoon.tee, status LIVE): compile rules (plain words, one clause per rule) into typed questions inside an enclave; the reply carries a TDX quote binding the work. lane "hardware" (default): the Phala Cloud TDX CVM (https://4c149b4f7ad6365a298f29e9b950379cdc4eb4f7-8790.dstack-pha-prod9.phala.network), paid from YOUR key’s one balance at cost + 20 % of the enclave time (no key → payment required, nothing delivered). lane "simulator": the dstack SIMULATOR (https://api.taifoon.dev/tee-sim): NOT a real enclave, the quote does not verify, not charged (the simulator lane costs nothing to run, so cost + 20% is 0: it is not charged, and it is never sold as an enclave). _PHALA_PROVISION_v1_: action "quote" | "provision" | "status" | "release" is a DEDICATED enclave of your own (unit enclave_hour: Phala’s live hourly rate + disk, + 20 %, from your one balance hour by hour): quote (GET /v1/access/enclave, open) → provision { compose, hours } (POST /v1/access/enclave: the first hour held; the layer deploys an allowlisted compose on Phala, accepts it with Phala’s verifier and hands you the endpoint) → status { id } (GET /v1/access/enclave/{id}) → release { id }. It stops when your balance cannot cover the next hour. DRY RUN until the owner’s live switch: nothing is deployed or taken, and every answer says so.

action.description: compile (default): one compile on a shared lane; the others: your own dedicated enclave

compose.description: provision/quote: an allowlisted compose id (taifoon-tee-seller) or its file’s sha256; absent = the first on the allowlist

name: taifoon_tee_compile
